# Third-party dependencies

This repository does not provide all of the external dependencies needed to build and run the program.

Instead, the required libraries are expected to be either installed on the system or placed under `include` (headers) and `lib` (shared libraries) in this folder.

Currently, the following libraries are required:

- libwebm ([repo](https://github.com/webmproject/libwebm)) (BSD-3-Clause)
